contradictions.what: ENDING/SAVINGS leave a 'residual' class (aeronautical engineers etc., restated by EO 3073) as continuing noncompetitive and say 'what survives ... remain noncompetitive', with later fate left to a later compilation. The held CSC text of the 29 Aug 1924 order strikes out the whole paragraph (Schedule B, Subdivision IV, para 1, War Department), i.e. the residual class, making those positions competitive. The residual is therefore NOT current; it ended 1924-08-29 (identification by compilation file name/date; the held text has no number or signature, same caveat as for EO 3073). Also EO 3356 (Nov 20, 1920) struck 'aeronautical mechanical draftsman' from the restated paragraph, a step not listed in ENDING earlier_end_tests.

Schedule B of the civil-service rules is hereby amended by striking out paragraph

nation the positions of aeronautical engineers, aeronautical mechanical engineers,
and aeronautical chemists.
